1.mascotDialogue: All the splitting na just bookkeeping, my pikin — the real sorting dey happen entirely for the merge step, comparing two already-sorted halves and interleaving dem correctly!

2.mascotDialogue: Lines 9 and 10 na the merge heart — compare the fronts of both halves, take the smaller, advance only that side. Lines 12 and 13 mop up whichever half still get leftover once the other don run dry.

3.mascotDialogue: This view dey show no swap at all — merge sort no dey swap for place, she dey write the smaller of two fronts into fresh position, with every comparison.

4.mascotDialogue: E easy to think the merge don finish the moment the main comparison loop end — but one side almost always go finish before the other, and forgetting to drain the leftover go lose real data, quietly.
